answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 161803 Country: Pakistan Title: Interpretation of dream Question: Yesterday was the night of Shab-e-Barat. I wanted to fast but could not because of my exams. But I offered my obligatory prayers and with it I offered Salatus tasbih and other nafl. I went to sleep right after. In my dream, I dreamt of it being the same night of Shab-e-Barat and I was offering more nafl and telling my sister/relative that I have offered more nafl then you have. Do you think this is a good dream? Can you please interpret it for me. Answer ID: 161803 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1152/1001/H=9/1439) Ma-shaAllah, it is nice dream. It means that your worship has been accepted by the grace of Allah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
